findings.title: Thông tin quyền hạn tự đóng khi chuyển qua ngưỡng mobile/desktop
steps: Resize to 390px or rotate across the 640px breakpoint
findings.expected: Keep permission information open while adapting layout.
findings.actual: The dialog closes automatically. Reproduced in both 1440→390 and 390→1440 transitions. Opening and scrolling the dialog directly at either size works.
findings.impact: Interrupts reading; user must reopen the information dialog. No settings data changed.
findings.likelyCause: DataSearch switches between desktop and MobileDataSearch trees at 640px. PositionPermissionsHelp owns dialog state inside the moved actions subtree, so it remounts and resets open=false.
findings.fix: Move permission-help dialog and open state into SettingsList, outside the responsive DataSearch actions subtree. Only the trigger moves between desktop and mobile layouts.

The initial check expected an overview heading. Source confirms /settings intentionally redirects to /settings/users; correct behavior verified.
Initial sequence acted before new rows finished rendering; repeated after visible row index changed, using real keyboard typing.

limits: Successful create/update/lock operations against the real backend were not exercised; existing system configuration and permissions were preserved.
Only nhandt01 used; role/permission denial matrix not covered.
Mobile/touch emulation was used, not a physical device. Browser/OS matrix and prolonged load testing not performed.
Failure/retry scenarios used controlled 503 responses, not actual server incidents.
Export verification checked successful download and XLSX archive signature; spreadsheet cell-by-cell correctness not audited.
originalTestResult: All seven settings pages passed core list/form/responsive checks. One minor UX finding confirmed: permission-help dialog closes when crossing the 640px responsive breakpoint. No JavaScript page errors or real configuration changes.
